segments.text: Code 47 | 100 marks | Physical Geography + Human Geography

rows: Subject learning rule A study of spatial patterns and processes on Earth. Explain each topic through cause -> process -> spatial pattern/landform -> effect -> diagram/map.

items.text: 4. Climate and Environmental Change, Pollution, Hazards and Conservation
5. Culture, Language, Religion, Ethnicity and Development
8. Political Geography, Tourism and Medical Geography
: Always ask where a pattern occurs, why it occurs there and how it changes across space.
: A labelled process diagram is better than a decorative sketch with no mechanism.
: State assumptions and limitations of Davis, Von Thünen, Weber, Burgess, Hoyt and other models.
: Climate, population and development figures change; attach source and year.
